channel.title: Newspin: latest timeline updates
channel.description: Newspin turns the biggest ongoing news stories in India, the US and around the world into clear, sourced timelines: what happened, when, and what comes next.

item.title: Nvidia & Huang: Huang agrees to appear before Congress
item.description: 13 Nov 2026 · Huang agrees to appear voluntarily before the relevant House committees, CNN reports. Senators from both parties call the case troubling, and some want Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick to testify too. Nvidia says its product roadmap and customer commitments continue.

item.title: Outlook outage: A first fix brings some servers back
item.description: ≈ 2:30 am IST, 13 Nov · Microsoft says it has validated a different way of running server health checks, bringing some affected servers back online, and starts applying it more widely. It says the cause was servers unexpectedly going offline, not extra traffic.

item.title: Outlook outage: Restored servers fail again
item.description: ≈ 4:30 am IST, 13 Nov · Microsoft says servers it returned to service can become unresponsive again once they receive traffic. It pauses deployments, limits some traffic to the affected systems and keeps restarting servers.

item.title: Outlook outage: No sustained recovery yet; not a cyber attack
item.description: ≈ 10 am IST, 13 Nov · As Europe wakes up, the outage is still widespread. Microsoft says its fixes are bringing partial recovery but not a sustained one, and a Microsoft executive says it was not caused by a cyber attack. No time is given for a full fix.

item.title: US midterms: Where the count stands
item.description: 13 Nov 2026 · As of 11:04 am IST on 13 November, AP's count shows Democrats with 255 House seats won and Republicans with 169; 11 House seats are not yet counted as won for either party. In the Senate, Democrats have 55 seats including 2 who caucus with them, and Republicans 44; 1 seat is not yet counted for either. These numbers may change.

item.title: Inflation: October inflation hits 6.09%, above the RBI's limit
item.description: 12 Nov 2026 · Retail inflation rises for a ninth month in a row to 6.09%, breaching the RBI's 6% upper limit for the first time since October 2024. Food inflation climbs to 8.94%, and rural inflation (6.63%) runs above urban (5.41%).

item.title: RBI rates: Inflation crosses 6% before the December meeting
item.description: 12 Nov 2026 · October retail inflation comes in at 6.09%, above the RBI's tolerance band. It is the last inflation reading before the 2–4 Dec policy meeting, and economists are now talking about another hike.

item.title: Nvidia & Huang: Jensen Huang resigns; CFO Colette Kress becomes interim CEO
item.description: 12 Nov 2026 · After a board meeting on Wednesday night, Nvidia says its co-founder has stepped down as chief executive. Chief financial officer Colette Kress takes over on an interim basis, and venture investor Harvey C. Jones becomes the company’s first board chair. The board is reported to be looking at outside candidates for the permanent role. Investigations by the FBI and Congress, and a shareholder class-action lawsuit, continue.

item.title: Nvidia & Huang: Shares fall 4% on the day he resigns
item.description: 12 Nov 2026 · Nvidia closes down about 4%, taking its fall from the 6 October record high to 30.5%, according to CNN. Bloomberg, citing Vanda Research, reports retail investors bought a record $111 million of Nvidia shares in the first 30 minutes of trading.

item.title: Outlook outage: Microsoft starts investigating email problems
item.description: ≈ 11:30 pm IST, 12 Nov · Shortly before 1 pm US Eastern time, Microsoft says it is investigating reports of users unable to reach Exchange Online mailboxes in the Americas. It soon says users in any region could be affected.

item.title: Outlook outage: Outage spreads across Microsoft 365
item.description: ≈ 11:56 pm IST, 12 Nov · Microsoft opens a wider incident at 1:26 pm ET: customers may be unable to connect to Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, Copilot and Defender XDR. Outlook problem reports on Downdetector reach about 130,000.

item.title: West Asia & oil: Trump says no deal needed; oil jumps 3%
item.description: 12 Nov 2026 · Trump posts that the US does not need a deal with Iran. Houthis claim attacks on Saudi energy sites, and Iran's military reports tankers hit in the strait. Brent settles 3.3% higher at $95.82. In India, PM Modi says the government absorbed ₹43 of a needed ₹50-a-litre diesel increase.

item.title: US trade deal: Goyal: India will have one of the 'best' deals
item.description: 12 Nov 2026 · Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal says India has negotiated a very good set of outcomes, while changes in US tariffs have led to further talks. Sources say the US midterm results will not affect the interim deal. A former US diplomat says both sides may aim to close phase one by the G20 summit next month.

item.title: Russian oil: Gulf overtakes Russia for the first time since the war
item.description: 12 Nov 2026 · India's crude imports from the Persian Gulf reach about 2.1 million barrels a day so far in November, above Russia's 1.8 million, as Hormuz flows recover and Russian oil loses its price edge on higher freight costs.

item.title: Electricity policy: CAG starts an audit of 39 state power distributors
item.description: 12 Nov 2026 · The Comptroller and Auditor General begins an integrated performance audit of 39 state-owned power distribution companies and five electricity departments, covering FY21 to FY26, including a survey of consumers. The final electricity policy is still not notified.

item.title: Budget 2027: Diesel support costs ₹14,000 crore a month, PM says
item.description: 12 Nov 2026 · PM Modi says crude's jump from $70 to $122 a barrel called for a diesel increase of at least ₹50 a litre, but the government raised it by ₹7 and absorbed the rest. He puts the cost at ₹14,000 crore every month, a pressure on the deficit going into the Budget.

item.title: Delhi air: Slight relief, still 'very poor'
item.description: 10 Nov 2026 · AQI eases to 345 at 8 am. Stage III stays in force.

item.title: Delhi air: Season high of 391; protesters detained
item.description: 9 Nov 2026 · AQI hits 391 at 7 am, the season's highest so far, with Bawana at 436. Police detain people protesting at India Gate for action on pollution. AAP leader Saurabh Bharadwaj alleges water is being sprayed on monitoring stations; that claim is his and has not been verified.

item.title: West Asia & oil: Iran's Hormuz plan goes to the White House
item.description: 9 Nov 2026 · Qatar's prime minister takes an Iranian proposal to reopen Hormuz to President Trump. Under the reported plan, the US would lift its blockade and release $8 billion in frozen funds. A Qatari official called one report of the terms false. Brent falls to its lowest close since 31 August.

item.title: Rupee: A six-month high of 93.70
item.description: 9 Nov 2026 · The rupee touches 93.70 per dollar in early trade, its strongest in about six months, as crude falls and foreign money flows back in. It has recovered more than 3% from its record low near 96.90, and closes the day at 93.93.

item.title: Delhi air: Diwali: worst festival air since 2021
item.description: 8 Nov 2026 · Delhi records an average AQI of 376 at 4 pm on Diwali, its highest festival-day reading since 2021.

item.title: Delhi air: Stage III invoked before Diwali
item.description: 6 Nov 2026 · With Delhi's daily average AQI at 382 and stations such as IIT Delhi and Rohini at 474, the commission invokes Stage III across Delhi-NCR with immediate effect.

item.title: Delhi air: Worst air in 288 days
item.description: 5 Nov 2026 · Delhi's 24-hour average AQI reaches 377, its worst in 288 days, with at least 10 stations above 400.

item.title: US midterms: Trump: 'I have total veto power'
item.description: Early Nov 2026 · President Trump tells The New York Times that he has veto power over legislation and is open to good ideas. Senate Democratic leader Chuck Schumer calls the results a 'generational remake' of the Senate map.

item.title: Rupee: RBI steps in; the rupee turns
item.description: Late Oct–5 Nov · After the RBI sells dollars and tightens currency rules, the rupee rises nearly 1% in October, one of Asia's best performers that month, and settles around 94.46 on 5 November.

item.title: US midterms: Seven Senate seats flip, including Texas
item.description: 4 Nov 2026 · Senate seats in North Carolina, South Carolina, Ohio, Texas, Kansas, Iowa and Maine flip from Republican to Democratic, NPR reports. Races in Mississippi and Alaska are too close to call on 4 November. The campaign was dominated by the cost of living.

item.title: US midterms: Election day, record midterm turnout
item.description: 3 Nov 2026 · Voters choose all 435 House seats and 35 Senate seats, plus governors. More than 124 million ballots are cast, above the previous midterm record of nearly 119 million in 2018, according to the University of Florida Election Lab.

item.title: Delhi air: Stage II as AQI crosses 300
item.description: 2 Nov 2026 · Delhi's air enters the 'very poor' band for the first time this season. With AQI at 324 by 4 pm, the commission brings in Stage II across the whole NCR.

item.title: West Asia & oil: Qatar talks: oil plunges about 8%
item.description: 2 Nov 2026 · After weekend mediation talks between Iran and Qatar, a draft proposal to end the war circulates, reportedly centred on reopening Hormuz. Brent settles 7.6% lower, even as tankers near the strait are hit.

item.title: Delhi air: Winter plan: older outside vehicles barred
item.description: 1 Nov 2026 · Delhi's winter action plan starts. Vehicles registered outside Delhi that do not meet BS-VI standards are barred from entering until 31 January 2027, with exemptions. The Delhi High Court refuses to stay the rule.

item.title: Delhi air: A clean day after rain: AQI 60
item.description: Late Oct 2026 · Rain brings Delhi's AQI down to 60, its cleanest October day in four years. It climbs to 117 on 31 October and 261 on 1 November.

item.title: West Asia & oil: Oil peaks near $118
item.description: Late Oct 2026 · Brent climbs to a late-October peak of about $118 a barrel after tankers are struck in the strait, its highest close in six months.

item.title: Delhi air: Stage I curbs as air turns 'poor'
item.description: 21 Oct 2026 · The air quality commission puts Stage I of the Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP) in force across Delhi-NCR, with Delhi's AQI at 244.

item.title: Russian oil: Trump waives the Russian-oil tariffs
item.description: 16 Oct 2026 · An executive order waives the sanctions and duties of up to 100% that the new US law allowed on the biggest buyers of Russian oil. The waiver is not specific to India and could be reversed.

item.title: West Asia & oil: Saudi pipeline hit; Brent above $107
item.description: 14 Sep 2026 · An Iranian ship is attacked in the Strait of Hormuz and Saudi Arabia's East–West pipeline, used to bypass the strait, is damaged in a drone attack. Brent crosses $107 even as the US says it is escorting more tankers.

item.title: Nvidia & Huang: New report alleges a second relationship, with a senior Nvidia executive
item.description: 11 Nov 2026 · The New York Times reports, citing five employees, that Huang is also suspected of a relationship with a married executive who reports directly to him. Nvidia has rules discouraging relationships between managers and subordinates. This is a reported allegation; Nvidia’s response had not been published in the coverage we reviewed. Analysts have started asking whether Huang could be forced to step aside, with no public succession plan.

item.title: Nvidia & Huang: Former US attorney and Wachtell Lipton hired to run the inquiry
item.description: 10 Nov 2026 · The board names Joon Kim, a former acting US Attorney, and the law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to lead the independent investigation. Nvidia’s losses since Monday reach close to $500 billion in market value, according to NBC News.

item.title: Nvidia & Huang: Shares slide; China rejects the claims
item.description: 9 Nov 2026 · Nvidia falls as much as 8% in early trading before recovering to about 4% down, while rivals AMD and Broadcom rise. China’s Foreign Ministry calls the allegations unsubstantiated. Huang pulls out of an AI industry CEO forum.

item.title: Nvidia & Huang: Board opens independent investigation; Huang admits infidelity
item.description: 8 Nov 2026 · A committee of independent directors with outside counsel will review the reports. The board says it has no reason to believe national security or company secrets were compromised and that it has confidence in Huang, who stays CEO. In a message to staff, Huang says he was unfaithful to his wife and will cooperate fully. President Trump calls him an honourable man and says he has not discussed the matter with him.

item.title: Nvidia & Huang: Incoming Democratic majority signals its own questions
item.description: 6 Nov 2026 · Bloomberg reports that the new Democratic majority in Congress is set to demand answers from Nvidia on keeping its AI chips out of China. The new Congress sits from 3 January.
